reviews.title: Repetitive Verses, Prayers, and Not Customizable
reviews.body: I really got to appreciate this app for helping you get your daily prayers in to stay connected with God, but it’s really getting to me that you can’t block apps longer to prevent you from being too carried away once you finish your 15 second prayer in this app and then go 3 hours doomscrolling right after. So please, if any developer that sees this review, please make the verses and prayers always new and dynamic at least. Thank you

reviews.title: So many ads, same prayer every time
reviews.body: Have used this app for a few months now. you need to watch a minimum of two 30 second ads just to complete the prayer and unlock your apps. but sometimes the ads glitch and you can be watching upwards of 2 minutes of ads. The app also gets stuck in loops where it gives you the same prayer every single time for weeks, which is a lot given you have to do it 3 times a day. I stop reading the prayer at this point because I have it memorized (which in hindsight is probably a good thing) but sometimes it can get stuck on weird prayers. I had this glitch around Halloween and it kept giving me a prayer about Hallows Eve and praying for the dead saints, which is unbiblical (Ecc. 9:5-6).  I have no intention of praying to dead humans instead of Christ. Great app in theory but poor execution.

reviews.title: When it works it’s great…

I’ve already paid my year subscription, and haven’t even used half of it yet. I’m not paying for it again after only about 3 months, and unless these bugs get fixed I probably won’t even use the free version. When it’s working it’s actually a really great tool to help me unplug from doom-scrolling and reconnect with God throughout the day…but it’s glitching so much it’s almost not usable anymore. Hope it fixes soon.

reviews.title: $32 A Month????
reviews.body: I rarely if not ever write a review for anything but I felt like I should for this. First I think this app could be very useful and helpful for anyone that wants to grow closer to God and further away for social media and the distractions that come from it. But second, asking someone to pay/subscribe for an app isn’t brand new or out of the norm these days, but paying $7.99 A WEEK is really expensive. That’s roughly $32 A MONTH and $384 A YEAR!!! That’s outrageous for something that’s supposedly to help people to get closer to God. In my personal opinion, it should be free, you shouldn’t take money from people if you honestly want to bring people closer to God. But I completely understand that apps cost money to make and maintain, so I wouldn’t be mad at a price/subscription, but $7.99 A WEEK is outrageous.
